outcome.reason: Customer mentioned legal advice and complaint to banking ombudsman, and asked about legal action.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. How can I help you?

Thank you for confirming. I am calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. As of today, a minimum payment of Rs 4820 was due on 2026-10-15 and has not yet been received.

Could you please let me know when you will be able to make this payment? If you have already paid, please let me know the date and mode of payment.

I’ve actually spoken to my lawyer about this, and they’ve advised me not to make any payments right now. I’m also in the process of filing a complaint with the banking ombudsman. Does the bank intend to take me to court over this? Yes or no?
